newsitem.title: PERU: PERU 28-DAY CDS DRAW 12.22 PCT AVG RATE AT SALE.
newsitem.headline: PERU 28-DAY CDS DRAW 12.22 PCT AVG RATE AT SALE.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru said Thursday it accepted bids for 28-day Certificates of Deposit (CDs) worth 70 million soles at an effective average annual rate of 12.22 percent during a bank auction BCQZ.
The CDs have an August 7 starting date.
The accepted bids also had a minimum rate of 10.50 percent and a maximum rate of 12.90 percent, the bank said.
At the last CD auction, 28-day CDs drew an average rate of 12.85 percent. At Wednesday's auction, the bank said it received bids on the CDs totalling 221.1 million soles.
The bank had offered 70 million soles worth of CDs.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
